claims.quote: `bun run capability --agents` has a headless `claude -p` session work each task of the corpus in a folder of its own outside the repository, with the task's statement, Lion's documentation, `./lion`, and `./try`, and grades what the agents wrote as a suite of its own
It stops starting tasks before what it spent could pass --budget
`./try` runs `solution.json` the way the grader does, with the inputs bound, and prints its value, or why it failed
what caused the tries that failed, by the rules in `agent-errors.json`
A gap is a task Lion cannot express yet, so no agent works it.
Held-out tasks keep their runs in their own folder, so nothing of them reaches the repository.
--agents            also have agents write a program for each corpus
